export const meta = {
  name: 'hello-two',
  description: 'Run two echo commands in parallel via two agents',
  phases: [{ title: 'Echo' }],
}
phase('Echo')
const results = await parallel([
  () => agent("Run the bash command 'echo hello-one' and reply with its output only.", {label: 'a:one', phase: 'Echo'}),
  () => agent("Run the bash command 'echo hello-two' and reply with its output only.", {label: 'a:two', phase: 'Echo'}),
])
return results
